-ša I

  • Meaning: "her" (3 f. sg. pron. suff. after subst.)
  • Lines: 196
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/-%C5%A1a%20I

abašmû I

  • Meaning: (a stone) M/jB, NA, often mag.
  • Lines: 189
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/aba%C5%A1m%C3%BB%20I

abnu I

  • Meaning: m. & f.; pl. abnū and abnātu(m) "stone" [NA4]
  • Logograms: NA4
  • Lines: 186
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abnu%20I

abu I

  • Meaning: "father" (st. constr. abi, occas. abu, ab; nom. with pron. suff. abī, M/NB, NA also abū(y)a; abūšu etc.; pl. abbū, O/MA abbā'ū, MB(Alal.), Am. abbūtu) [AD]
  • Logograms: AD
  • Lines: 75
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abu%20I

abullu I

  • Meaning: f.; pl. abullātu(m) "gate (of city or large building)" [ABUL] a. kawītum "outer gate"; maṣṣār a., ša a., mār a., bēl a. "gatekeeper"; OB a. šūdûm "to acquaint s.o. with gate", i.e. to forbid exit; a. edēlu/pehû "to shut/seal up gate"; Bab. "gate tax"; at Nuzi, as a public authority; transf. "entrance" to region, nether world, heaven etc.; OB ext., jB lex. (parts of the organs, esp. portal fissure of the liver);
  • Logograms: ABUL
  • Lines: 135
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abullu%20I

adi I

  • Meaning: "until, as far as" [EN]
  • Logograms: EN, A.RÁ
  • Lines: 55
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/adi%20I

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 7, 11, 25, 49, 54, 131, 195
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

alālu II

  • Meaning: "to hang up, suspend" Bab.
    • G: (a/u, pres. OB i'allal, jB illal) "hang (up)" people as punishment, "hang up, suspend" objects; stat. OB ext. "is 'hanging'" (wr. halil etc.)
    • Gt: "be tangled; be allied with" also in PNs OAkk, OB
    • D: stat. only ext. "is hung (about) with" s.th.
    • Dt: pass. of D
    • Š: jB in qāta šūlulu "stay o.'s hand"
    • N: of objects "be hung up"; of lamentation "hang (in the air)"?
  • Lines: 174
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81lu%20II

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 9, 46, 172, 176
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

ana I

  • Meaning: (aš-š... etc.) "to, for" (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n to following consonant (OA often wr. a)) (prep., governs subst. in gen., pers. pron. in dat.) [from MB onwards DIŠ; O/MB occas. NAM; M/jB ŠÈ]
  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ
  • Lines: 1, 6, 8, 10, 11, 15, 17, 24, 25, 38, 45, 48, 53, 79, 82, 84, 85, 86, 130, 137, 141, 144, 147, 150, 153, 156, 159, 162, 166, 174, 176
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ana%20I

annû I

  • Meaning: OB occas. with nunation "this, those" [j/NB NE; ŠEŠ (for m. pl. annûti)]; OB f. sg. annītum "this matter"; annītam lā annītam 'this one, not this one', "one way or another"; a. ū a. "various"; NA a(n)nûte ... a(n)nûte ... "some ..., others ..."; (a)kī (h)anni(ma) "thus, in the same way";
  • Logograms: ,
  • Lines: 136
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ann%C3%BB%20I

anāku I

  • Meaning: "I; me" [Bogh. GÁ.E] as pred. freq. anākuma; OB ša anāku "as for me"; NB also acc. (to stress a pron. suff.), dat.
  • Logograms: GÁ.E
  • Lines: 3, 9
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/an%C4%81ku%20I

apālu I

  • Meaning: "to pay; answer"
    • G: (a/u; NB pres. once ihappal ?)
    • Gtn: iter. "pay", "stand in for" on separate occasions
    • Gt: "answer one another, have discussion", "stand in for permanently"
    • D: "be held responsible"
    • Š: "make s.o. answer"
    • N: "be paid off, become satisfied"
  • Lines: 50
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ap%C4%81lu%20I

arallû I

  • Meaning: "netherworld" O/jB [ARALI(=É.KUR.BAD)] jB šad a. "mountain of the netherworld", also desig. of temple;
  • Logograms: ARALI ARALI=É.KUR.BAD
  • Lines: 41
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/arall%C3%BB%20I

arkat I

  • Meaning: "after" Bab., OA
  • Lines: 141
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/arkat%20I

arkatu I

  • Meaning: "rear" [EGIR; A.GA]
  • Logograms: EGIR, A.GA
  • Lines: 144, 147, 150, 153, 156, 159, 162, 166
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/arkatu%20I

arāmu I

  • Meaning: "to cover" Bogh., jB
    • G: (i/i) "cover s.th. with s.th." (= 2 acc.), drum with skin, object with gold; "place (tablet) in a (clay) case"; ext., bodily parts; of cloud "cover" moon, planet; of smoke "veil" face; transf. "cover" s.o.'s face etc. with radiance, gloom etc.
    • D: "cover up"
  • Lines: 46
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ar%C4%81mu%20I

attā I

  • Meaning: "you" (2 m. sg. pron.)
  • Lines: 54, 89
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/att%C4%81%20I

awātu I

  • Meaning: "word; matter" [INIM]
  • Logograms: INIM
  • Lines: 53, 130
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/aw%C4%81tu%20I

awīlūtu I

  • Meaning: "humanity" [(NAM.)LÚ.U18/19.LU; LÚ- ]
  • Logograms: , , NAM.LÚ.LÚ.MEŠ
  • Lines: 51
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/aw%C4%ABl%C5%ABtu%20I

ašru III

  • Meaning: pl. m. & f., "place, site" [KI]
  • Logograms: KI
  • Lines: 58
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%C5%A1ru%20III

ašāgu I

  • Meaning: (a common spiny plant, phps.) "camelthorn" Bab., Bogh. [(GIŠ.)KIŠI16]; iṣṣur a. (a small bird)
  • Logograms: KIŠI₁₆, GIŠ.KIŠI₁₆
  • Lines: 188
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%C5%A1%C4%81gu%20I

aṣû I

  • Meaning: "to go out", + vent. "come out" (from = ina, ištu, acc.)
    • G: (perf. ittaṣi, NA ittūṣi) [È; MB in PNs also UD]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [È.MEŠ]
    • Gt: separative of G "go away (for good)"
    • Š: Mari
    • Štn: pass. of Š
    • Št2: "quarrel, pick a fight"
  • Logograms: È, UD, È.MEŠ
  • Lines: 39, 45, 84, 87, 170
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%E1%B9%A3%C3%BB%20I

bakû I

  • Meaning: "to weep"
    • G: (i/i) [ÉR] of human; of animal "cry"; also + dat. "weep over; weep for"
    • Gtn: iter. of G [ÉR.MEŠ]
    • Š: caus. of G
  • Logograms: ÉR, ÉR.MEŠ
  • Lines: 2
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/bak%C3%BB%20I

balāṭu I

  • Meaning: "life" [TI(.LA); Am. TIL(.LA); NB also TIN] esp. ana balāṭ X "for X's life"; "vigour, good health"; OA balāṭukka "during your life-time"; O/MB lā balāṭu "loss of life"; O/jB(lit.) "(eternal) life"; šipat/šammi b. "life(-giving) spell/plant"; OB, Am. "provisions"; NA "food" for the gods; OA "(meagre) livelihood, small profit"; st. abs. Bogh., j/NB ana balāṭ 'within a life-time' = "next year";
  • Logograms: TI TI.LA, TIL TIL.LA, TIN
  • Lines: 14, 76, 77
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/bal%C4%81%E1%B9%ADu%20I

bašû I

  • Meaning: "to be (at hand, available); exist" [GÁL]
    • G: (i/i; no perf.) "be in existence, available"; of eyes, ears "be fixed on, attentive"; of task, responsibility "lie with" s.o.; of power, characteristic "be owned" by s.o.; pret. ibši "was/were" (emphatic); M/NA pres. ibašši, also pl., as adv. ~ "really, in fact; some"; j/NB mala bašû "as much as there is available, everything, everybody"; adi lā bašê (infin.) 'until non-existence' of destruction, disease
    • Š: "bring into being"
    • N: ingress. of G
    • Ntn: "happen repeatedly"
  • Logograms: GÁL
  • Lines: 80, 83, 140, 143, 146, 149, 152, 155, 158, 161, 165, 188
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ba%C5%A1%C3%BB%20I

biri- I

  • Meaning: "among, between" Bab. [DAL.BA.(AN.)NA] with pron. suff., after ina or ša; occas. after st. constr.: OB kasap birīni "our shared silver"; j/NB also after ana, ultu; loc.-adv. (ina) biru(m)- OB(Susa), occas. M/jB; spatially "between", "(from) among"; of bilateral relations "between", MB māmīt birīni "our mutual oath"; Ug. (ina) beri X u (ina) beri Y "between X and Y"; jB(Ass.) as adv. ina beri "in between";
  • Logograms: DAL.BA.NA DAL.BA.AN.NA
  • Lines: 17
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/biri-%20I

bābu I

  • Meaning: pl. m. & f. "gate, door" [KÁ]
  • Logograms: KÁ, ME.NI
  • Lines: 42
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/b%C4%81bu%20I

bāštu I

  • Meaning: ~ "dignity, (source of) pride"? OAkk, Bab., OA, Am. [TÉŠ] of deity, person; esp. in PNs of protective force; of building, orchard as "pride" of city, land etc.; jB ṣubat b. "formal dress";
  • Logograms: TÉŠ
  • Lines: 188
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/b%C4%81%C5%A1tu%20I

bēru III

  • Meaning: "double hour, league" [DANNA(=KASKAL.GÍD)]
  • Logograms: DANNA
  • Lines: 82, 139, 142, 145, 148, 151, 154, 157, 160, 163, 167, 169, 170
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/b%C4%93ru%20III

dagālu I

  • Meaning: "to see, look"
    • G: (a/u)
    • Gtn: iter. of G of eyes "look repeatedly"; "aim" a bow "repeatedly"; pān X d. "constantly obey"
    • Gt: "belong to henceforth"
    • Š: caus. of G "make see, look", esp. in pān(ī) X š. "cause to wait for; make subject to"; NA (ina/ana p.) š. "hand over, transfer ownership of s.th. to s.o.; put under s.o.'s command"; "entrust" with a task
    • N: in jB ana X iddagil "attention was on X"
  • Lines: 174
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/dag%C4%81lu%20I
